# DS-Ngr

> Nagarro's design system: React components, design tokens and usage rules. Never write a token, component or prop you have not seen in the inventory below. A name that fits the grammar is not proof that it exists.

## Inventory (read first)

- [ds-index.json](ds-index.json): generated inventory — every component with its props, every token by layer, and `tokens.absences` (names the grammar implies that do not exist)
- [tokens.css](tokens.css): every token definition, light and dark
- [Design Tokens/vocabulary.json](Design%20Tokens/vocabulary.json): the closed word lists every token name is built from, plus the banned synonyms

## Instructions

- [AI.md](AI.md): rules for apps that consume DS-Ngr — components, layout, tokens, navigation
- [AI-short.md](AI-short.md): the same rules, condensed
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for working inside this repo — structure, token system, component generation

## Specs

- [specs/foundations/foundations.md](specs/foundations/foundations.md): color, typography, spacing, radius, sizing, effects, focus, motion
- [specs/patterns/README.md](specs/patterns/README.md): page patterns (dashboard, data page, form page, detail drawer, kanban board)
- `src/components/<tier>/<Name>/<Name>.spec.md`: per-component use cases, anti-patterns and spatial contract

## When the inventory doesn't have it

Stop and ask. Say: "This token follows the grammar, but I cannot verify that it exists."
